# FlexDays

> FlexDays is the HR super app: one simple, affordable app for leave management, timesheets, a one-tap time tracker, and company events and announcements, on iOS, Android and the web. It is free for teams of up to 10 employees, then $2 per employee per month, at any company size. FlexDays is launching soon and taking early-access signups on its waitlist.

FlexDays is built for companies that want to replace spreadsheets, email chains, messaging apps and expensive legacy HR systems with one modern app. It sets up in under 5 minutes, needs no IT team, and works for companies of any size, from small teams to 500+ employees. It supports teams in any country, with public holidays and working weeks set automatically by country and location. FlexDays is built by beanvoid, a product studio.

## Key facts

- Product: FlexDays, the HR super app
- Status: launching soon (pre-launch), with an early-access waitlist at https://www.flexdays.app/#waitlist
- Pricing: free for up to 10 employees with no time limit and no credit card; $2 per employee per month above 10 employees (you only pay for employees over 10); no setup fees; cancel anytime; 14-day refunds
- Billing: handled securely by Paddle
- Platforms: native iOS and Android apps plus a full web portal, always in sync
- Setup: under 5 minutes with a guided 6-step checklist (company, public holidays, working days, leave types, org structure, employee import)
- Who it's for: HR teams, founders, owners and managers at companies of any size, worldwide, with a focus on Southeast Asia and the Middle East & North Africa (MENA)
- Made by: beanvoid (https://www.beanvoid.com/)
- Contact: hello@beanvoid.com

## Features in the first release (Phase 1)

- Leave management: employees request leave in seconds; balances for annual, sick, WFH and custom leave types update automatically; carry-over rules; part-time schedules
- Timesheets: connected directly to leave and working schedules, so there is no double entry
- One-tap time tracker: start a timer with one tap and every minute flows straight into the timesheet
- Working schedules: working days, weekends and shifts set per location
- Team-based approvals: multi-level approval chains configured per team, without IT
- Multi-country public holidays: applied automatically by country and location
- Bulk employee onboarding: import a whole team from an Excel file
- Smart notifications: real-time push notifications for approvals, balance reminders and team updates
- Events and announcements: share company news and events with everyone, a location, a department, a team or specific people, with a push notification and a spot on the team calendar

## Roadmap

- Coming next: HR analytics and leave heatmaps, payroll integration, single sign-on (SSO), leave statement PDF export, leave swaps between employees, extra workday requests
- Longer term: recruitment and applicant tracking, performance reviews, org chart and directories, benefits and compensation, onboarding workflows, and an AI HR assistant that handles requests in plain language (for example "Who's off next week?")
